reply1:
I rewrote this rather than interviewing you, since a short cold email only needs a tighter ask. It leads with the offer and the 99.2% figure, merges the two questions into one request, and swaps "finished last year with" for plain wording.

A real detail would help: if you already serve a grocery or food client, naming them or giving a typical lead time for last-minute requests would make this land harder. I didn't add one because none was in the source.

<final>
Subject: Same-day refrigerated delivery for Fairview Markets

Hi [First Name],

We run refrigerated trucks with same-day delivery within 250 miles, and our on-time rate last year was 99.2%. Could we cover Fairview Markets' regular routes or last-minute deliveries?

Do you have 15 minutes next week to talk about where we might fit?

Best,
[Your Name]
[Company]
[Phone]
</final>
